title: Beyond Infraction Scores: Failure-Boundary Profiles for Closed-Loop Evaluation of Driving and Robot Navigation Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Closed-loop driving benchmarks in CARLA rank agents by a driving score that multiplies route completion by an infraction penalty. This score does not distinguish an agent that stops in front of an obstacle from one that pushes past it. In a corridor closed by two parked cars, for example, one agent that drives through with contact averages 52.2 on the blocked widths, while the agents that stop average between 37.8 and 40.6. We propose failure-boundary profiles, an evaluation in which each scenario family varies one measured factor, such as corridor width or the time gap in oncoming traffic, and each variant is certified from measurement as one where the agent should proceed or one where it should stop. Along this axis we estimate two curves per agent, commitment (the probability of attempting the passage) and competence (the probability of passing without contact), and locate where each crosses one half, with intervals that account for

translated_title: 超越违规评分：用于驾驶与机器人导航智能体闭环评估的失败边界剖面
translated_abstract: CARLA中的闭环驾驶基准通过驾驶评分对智能体进行排名，该评分由路线完成度乘以违规惩罚得出。这一评分无法区分在障碍物前恰当停下的智能体与强行挤过去的智能体。例如，在一条被两辆停放汽车封闭的走廊场景中，一个发生接触强行通过的智能体在被阻挡的宽度上平均得分为52.2，而选择停下的智能体平均得分仅在37.8到40.6之间。我们提出了“失败边界剖面”这一评估方法：每个场景族仅变化一个可测量的因素，例如走廊宽度或对向来车的时间间隔，并且每个变体都通过测量被认证为智能体“应该通过”或“应该停止”的情形。沿此轴，我们为每个智能体估计两条曲线：承诺度（尝试通过的概率）与能力度（无接触通过的概率），并定位各自跨越二分之一（0.5）的临界点，其置信区间考虑了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“失败边界剖面”评估框架，通过逐级变化单一可测量因素（如走廊宽度、对车间隔）并认证每个变体应为“通过”或“停止”，进而估计智能体的承诺曲线与能力曲线及其临界点，弥补了CARLA传统违规评分无法区分“该停就停”与“强行通过”两类智能体的根本缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes failure-boundary profiles—an evaluation scheme that varies one measured factor per scenario family and certifies each variant as proceed-or-stop—thereby estimating each agent's commitment and competence curves to overcome CARLA's infraction-based driving score's inability to distinguish agents that appropriately stop from those that force through obstacles.
